title: Warm Tunisian Cheese Curds Gallette
description: A cozy and comforting Tunisian dish featuring cheese curds, honey, and spices. Perfect for a quick weekend breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: cheese curds
ingredients.notes: fresh, non-vegan option or vegan alternative

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.notes: or maple syrup for vegan option

ingredients.name: candy
ingredients.notes: crushed peanut butter cups or chopped candy canes

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: or flax eggs for vegan option

instructions: Dust a surface with flour and roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a greased 9-inch round cake pan or a skillet.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, honey, and spices. Add the crumbled cheese curds and mix until combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the dough, making sure to cover the entire surface.
Sprinkle the crushed candy on top of the egg mixture.
Dollop spoonfuls of the remaining cheese curds on top of the candy.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with parsley, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
